What's new?

View all changes
Nov 10, 2025
99 Language Support & Auto-Detection
Whisper4Windows now supports transcription in 99 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and many more. Auto-detection intelligently identifies the spoken language, or manually select your preferred language for optimal accuracy.
OCT 20, 2025
GPU Acceleration & Fast Text Injection
10x faster transcription with NVIDIA GPU support. Text now injects instantly via clipboard paste instead of character-by-character. Customizable global shortcuts let you control recording from anywhere.
